mentions.name: BranchBay
mentions.description: A pair of interconnected, Rust-native desktop apps aimed at replacing paid developer subscriptions: a Git GUI offered as an alternative to Gitkraken and an SSH client as an alternative to Termius, with the goal of getting developers off those subscriptions.
mentions.problem: Developers are locked into paid subscriptions for Git GUIs (Gitkraken) and SSH clients (Termius).
mentions.audience: Developers paying for Gitkraken and Termius subscriptions.
mentions.source_excerpt: this year I've been trying to get developers off Gitkraken and Termius subscriptions by building 2 Rust native interconnected apps.
mentions.author: adriant93
